profile.headline: Automation transformation!
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in VMware, AWS EC2, Docker, Linux, SQL, bash scripting, git, Jenkins, Ansible, HTML, Javascript, and Cascading Style Sheets (CSS). Strong engineering professional with an Associate of Science (AS) focused in Computer Engineering from New Hampshire Technical Institute.

positions.title: Principle Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Merrimack, New Hampshire, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Release Engineer (Linux)
positions.description: Automated software installs and OS configuration using ansible

positions.title: Software Release Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with a team of four to transition from a monolithic build system to a CI/CD build pipeline using GitLab.
Created Docker images using dockerfiles for use in the pipeline.
Implemented and managed a Sonatype Nexus 3 artifactory built in JAVA that runs on Apache Karaf OSGi.
Built and maintained the company YUM repository for RPM-based distributions. Also, created RPM packages.
Uploaded RPM packages to a CDN.

positions.title: Automation and Virtual Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Used bash scripts and Ansible playbooks to automate the creation of CentOS and AMI Linux instances on VMware and AWS.
Customized Python Pyvmomi modules for VMware builds.
Sent build and test notifications to a Jenkins server.
Responsible for coding the install process of the software deliverable. Including, deploying SQL databases that used MySQL and PostgreSQL.

positions.title: Release and QA Engineer
positions.description:
The main point of contact for VMware and AWS resource distribution for Development.
Maintained the CentOS build server and SVN repository.
Used make to compile and bundle Perl and C executables.
Responsible for all Bitrock and Perl install code.
Verified Bugzilla tickets and tested software installs.

positions.title: LAMP Stack Developer
positions.description: Programmed Web CGI for Apache running on CentOS. This code ran on Linux and leveraged MySQL

positions.title: LAMP Stack Developer
positions.description:
Programmed Apache Web CGI code using Perl and Javascript. This code ran on Linux and leveraged
MySQL and PostgreSQL.

positions.title: Software QA Automation
positions.description: Was in charge of moving the automated smoke tests from bash to Perl.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed code for the network monitoring software using C
